subject: L1·L2·L3 29 Oct: OpenAI will buy Google AI chips as computing demand keeps rising.
lead: OpenAI will buy Google AI chips as computing demand keeps rising.

tldr.text: OpenAI will buy Google AI chips as computing demand keeps rising.
Apple launched a touchscreen MacBook Pro starting at $2,899.
India cut prices on 543 anti-cancer medicine brands.

hero.text: The big picture is Nvidia detour: cloud and model companies are testing non-Nvidia chips and tooling for AI work. Today's OpenAI deal for Google AI chips pushed that pattern, alongside Google’s coding and cybersecurity Gemini launch and continued pressure on AI compute supply.

6318bf62f2.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon for coding and cybersecurity
6318bf62f2.explain: Google says Gemini 4 Carbon is its newest frontier model, with stronger coding, long-horizon agent tasks, and cybersecurity work than Gemini 4 Argon. It tops the updated Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and posts leading scores on security benchmarks for finding vulnerabilities, testing exploitability, and patching code. Google will roll it out first to select cyber defenders and trusted partners.

why.text: Early access to defenders could shape how AI is used for vulnerability research and secure coding before wider release.

7a44b0a9a5.headline: Apple launches a touchscreen MacBook Pro starting at $2,899
7a44b0a9a5.explain: Apple has released a new touchscreen MacBook Pro. The laptop starts at $2,899.

why.text: A higher-priced MacBook Pro with touch input expands Apple’s premium laptop line.

3a45e06e0f.headline: B2B quick commerce startup Zorit raises Rs 27 crore
3a45e06e0f.explain: Zorit, formerly Bijnis, raised nearly Rs 27 crore in a round led by Sparrow Capital, with Info Edge, WaterBridge, Better Capital and angels joining. The India-based startup sells inventory to offline retailers through locally stocked dark stores, meaning small warehouses used for fast delivery. It says it runs 12 dark stores in 12 cities and has Rs 120 crore in annualised sales.

why.text: More capital should help Zorit expand its retailer supply network and quick-delivery model.

63c9f69881.headline: QwikBuild raises $2.3 million for enterprise AI software and agents
63c9f69881.explain: QwikBuild raised $2.3 million in pre-seed funding from Globalway, Blume Ventures, Marsshot and DeVC, plus angel investors. The Bengaluru startup builds bespoke enterprise software and AI agents that automate business operations and integrate with systems like SAP and Salesforce. It also formed a joint venture with Globalway to expand into Japan.

why.text: The round gives QwikBuild more capital to push its enterprise AI tools into new markets, including Japan.

692a1558f7.headline: Let’s Game Now raises Rs 30 crore to build Indian Super Gaming League
692a1558f7.explain: Let’s Game Now raised Rs 30 crore in a round co-led by Anand Mahindra and Bestvantage Investments, with a UAE family office also participating. The company runs gaming and esports tournaments, live broadcasts, and brand activations across South and Southeast Asia. It says the money will accelerate development of the Indian Super Gaming League.

why.text: The funding supports a larger push into esports leagues and tournament infrastructure.

6ae4878ff8.headline: Karnataka minister Priyank Kharge urges IT workers to keep learning
6ae4878ff8.explain: Karnataka IT Minister Priyank Kharge said AI is changing jobs fast and that IT professionals must keep upgrading their skills. He spoke at the launch of RSM US Integrated Services India’s new office in Bengaluru. Kharge also highlighted Nipuna Karnataka, a state skilling program that brings industry into training design and links some government support to employability outcomes.

why.text: Karnataka’s skilling policy is being tied more closely to the jobs companies say they need filled.

29099ec00f.headline: Report says Chinese activity raises risks for Pacific undersea cables
29099ec00f.explain: A new report says undersea cable projects owned by US firms such as Google and Meta face major risk from sabotage in the Pacific. It cites Chinese research ships spending unusual time surveying cables and commercial ships being investigated for cutting cables in European and Asian waters. The report comes from the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission, which advises Congress.

why.text: Damage to these cables can disrupt Internet traffic and raise the cost of protecting critical infrastructure.

0ebb7cec19.headline: US loan funds nuclear plant upgrades for data centers
0ebb7cec19.explain: Constellation Energy will receive $5 billion in government loans to modernize nuclear reactors. Most of the extra power is already committed to Google, Amazon and Meta.

why.text: The loan backs power supply for the huge electricity demand of major data center operators.

cd7b21ad37.headline: Chip stocks rise after SK Hynix posts record quarterly profit
cd7b21ad37.explain: Asian chip stocks jumped after SK Hynix reported third-quarter operating profit of 83.33 trillion won, up 632% from a year earlier. Micron, AMD, Arm and Marvell also rose as investors bet on stronger AI-related chip demand before earnings from Microsoft and Alphabet. SK Hynix makes advanced memory chips used in AI systems.

why.text: The results added fresh momentum to AI-linked chip shares ahead of big tech earnings.

37be22d33d.headline: OpenAI to buy Google AI chips as computing demand rises
37be22d33d.explain: OpenAI is set to purchase Google’s AI chips, according to the headline. The deal comes as demand for computing resources keeps rising.

why.text: More chip buying points to continued pressure on AI compute supply.

8d743f5fea.headline: US DOJ asks about Nvidia’s purchase of Hugging Face
8d743f5fea.explain: The US Department of Justice is inquiring into Nvidia’s purchase of Hugging Face, according to sources. Hugging Face is a major platform for hosting and sharing AI models.

why.text: The inquiry could affect whether and how the acquisition moves forward.

da0575cf03.headline: Info Edge posts 87% profit jump and approves Rs 150 crore investment
da0575cf03.explain: Info Edge, the parent of Naukri, reported consolidated net profit of Rs 650 crore for Q2 FY27, up 87.1% year on year. Revenue from operations rose 12.2% to Rs 904 crore, helped by Rs 428 crore in other income. The board also declared a Rs 3 interim dividend and approved a Rs 150 crore investment in subsidiary Redstart Labs.

why.text: Strong investment income lifted profits, while the new capital injection supports future technology spending.

5a2809d5ba.headline: Cognizant may invest in Sarvam at up to $4 billion valuation
5a2809d5ba.explain: Sarvam AI is reportedly in talks to raise about $300 million from Cognizant at a valuation of $3.5 billion to $4 billion. Sarvam builds foundation models, infrastructure and enterprise AI tools for Indian-language and government use cases. It has already raised $234 million in its Series B and counts HCLTech as an investor.

why.text: A Cognizant stake would deepen interest from large IT services firms in AI model builders.

130ad7ecea.headline: India cuts prices on 543 anti-cancer medicine brands
130ad7ecea.explain: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority has revised the maximum retail prices of 543 anti-cancer brands, with new rates taking effect on November 9. Some cuts are steep: Dr Reddy’s Azacytin falls from ₹6,337 to ₹1,495.04, and RPG Life Sciences’ Anarzole from ₹695.76 to ₹73 for 10 tablets. The list covers different strengths and pack sizes, and will be updated as more company data comes in.

why.text: Cancer patients could see lower out-of-pocket costs as trade margins on selected anti-cancer medicines are capped.

bb63faf531.headline: ED attaches Jauhar University land and buildings in Rampur
bb63faf531.explain: The Enforcement Directorate has attached land and buildings of Mohammad Ali Jauhar University in Rampur worth about ₹1,170 crore, in a money-laundering case linked to the Maulana Mohammad Ali Jauhar Trust. The agency says the case stems from 26 FIRs alleging land grabs, diversion of public funds, and misuse of government contracts. Among those named is Mohammad Azam Khan, the jailed Samajwadi Party leader and former Uttar Pradesh minister.

why.text: The assets are now attached in the money-laundering case against the Trust, Azam Khan and others.

f9342fdb96.headline: AI search helped police trace a spurious liquor racket in Dewas
f9342fdb96.explain: Police in Madhya Pradesh’s Dewas district say 26-year-old Ajay Rathore used AI tools to look up how to make liquor at home, then used the internet to find suppliers and buy chemicals from Indore. Investigators say the liquor was sold in discarded bottles mixed with genuine stock, and they are checking whether it caused 13 suspected hooch deaths in Chandana and Binjana villages. Eleven people have been arrested so far.

why.text: Forensic tests will decide whether the liquor was contaminated and linked to the suspected deaths.

b451214da1.headline: BJP wins two Bihar Legislative Council seats and leads in one more
b451214da1.explain: In Bihar’s eight-seat Legislative Council election, the BJP won the Tirhut Teachers’ and Kosi Graduates’ seats and was leading in Darbhanga Graduates’. The JD(U), RJD, Jan Suraaj Party and Independents each won one seat, while Congress failed to open its account. Counting in Darbhanga was briefly disrupted after a dispute between NDA and RJD counting agents.

why.text: The final Darbhanga result was still pending when counting was reported.

1abf129f2d.headline: Netanyahu bloc leads in Israel election but falls short of majority
1abf129f2d.explain: With 85.6% of ballots counted, Israel’s Central Elections Committee had the pro-Netanyahu bloc on 53 seats and the bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot on 48 in the 120-seat Knesset. Arab-led parties were on 19 seats, and no bloc had reached the 61 needed to form a government. Turnout was 77.7%, the highest in more than two decades.

why.text: Coalition talks could stretch for weeks because neither bloc has a majority.

775bae7b29.headline: Israel’s double-envelope votes could still change the seat count
775bae7b29.explain: Israel still has hundreds of thousands of special ballots to count after the regular vote, which left Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc short of a majority. These double-envelope ballots are cast by people who cannot vote at their usual polling station, including soldiers, reservists, hospital patients and evacuees. Officials must verify that each voter did not cast a ballot twice before adding them to the tally.

why.text: The remaining ballots could alter the final seat split and shape coalition negotiations.

b45fed4ab7.headline: Flávio Bolsonaro arrives in Miami with family
b45fed4ab7.explain: Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro and his family arrived in Miami after he refused to concede the election to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Brazil’s Supreme Court had ordered him to surrender his passports within 24 hours, citing the risk of flight in a money-laundering probe. The US State Department said it would grant visas to him and his family.

why.text: The move could further strain relations between Brazil and the United States.

ffb43d61bc.headline: Federal Reserve keeps US interest rates unchanged
ffb43d61bc.explain: The Federal Open Market Committee held the federal funds rate steady, matching market expectations, though two officials voted for a quarter-point hike. The article says inflation is still above the Fed’s 2% target, with energy prices, tariffs and strong AI-related spending adding pressure. Markets now turn to the next PCE inflation report for clues on future moves.

why.text: Investors are watching for more rate hikes if inflation stays elevated.

77fb78cc35.headline: World Bank warns commodity prices may jump 23% in 2026
77fb78cc35.explain: The World Bank says energy, food and metals prices are rising sharply and could climb further if Middle East fighting worsens or Russian oil infrastructure is hit again. It projects global energy prices up 32% in 2026, Brent crude averaging $92 a barrel, food prices up just over 10% this year, and metals prices up 25% next year. The bank says the shock could worsen inflation, food insecurity and growth.

why.text: Higher commodity prices would keep inflation pressure elevated worldwide.

09f2489496.headline: Real Madrid apologises to China over Mbappé Mao remarks
09f2489496.explain: Real Madrid apologised after China’s state broadcaster CCTV rejected the club’s initial defence of Kylian Mbappé’s remarks about Mao Zedong. China Media Group said Mbappé crossed a line, and the dispute has already suspended La Liga broadcasts in China and cost Mbappé sponsorships. Mbappé later said his comment was ill-judged and had hurt people in China.

why.text: La Liga’s Chinese broadcast and commercial ties are now disrupted.

2a56ab9187.headline: Zoo searches for capybara 7 months after escape
2a56ab9187.explain: Marwell Zoo in Winchester says a capybara named Samba, missing since March, has been photographed again by wildlife cameras. Zoo staff say they know roughly where she is but are moving carefully to avoid frightening her, and have set up more cameras and a feeding area. Samba escaped less than 24 hours after arriving, while a second capybara was quickly found.

why.text: The zoo is still trying to recover the animal without pushing it farther away.

efe3a07dc6.headline: Spreadsheet collector passes 1,000 software items
efe3a07dc6.explain: Ariel Fischman, a financial adviser and Guinness World Record holder, says his collection of physical spreadsheet software has grown past 1,000 items. He first set the record in 2018 with 506 copies, after starting to collect software while researching the history of electronic accounting. He points back to VisiCalc, created in 1978 by Dan Bricklin and Bob Frankston, as the breakthrough spreadsheet program.

why.text: His collection keeps expanding the world’s largest archive of physical spreadsheet software.

call.prediction: At least one major AI company will publicly adopt Google chips or another non-Nvidia stack for production work.
call.measure: public production deployment or purchase announcement using non-Nvidia AI chips
call.could_fail_because: OpenAI’s purchase may stay limited, or other firms may keep buying Nvidia gear.

quiz.question: Which of today's stories is evidence for Nvidia detour?
options: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon for coding and cybersecurity
Apple launches a touchscreen MacBook Pro starting at $2,899
OpenAI to buy Google AI chips as computing demand rises
quiz.why: It shows a major AI buyer choosing Google chips, not only Nvidia.

quiz.question: Which headline would weaken Compute cash?
options: Major AI firms cut spending and delay new compute purchases
Chip suppliers report record orders from AI builders
AI model startup closes a larger funding round at a higher valuation
quiz.why: That would cut against the idea that AI firms are raising or spending more capital for compute.

quiz.question: Why does India cuts prices on 543 anti-cancer medicine brands matter?
options: It mainly changes export rules for generic painkillers
Cancer patients could face lower out-of-pocket costs on selected medicines
It could expand the government's control over hospital ownership
quiz.why: The story says capped trade margins should lower what patients pay.
